analysis: Reviewed the changes to docs/developer/build.md (head text, lines 447-1246) and docs/developer/test.md (patch hunks around line 3521). All are documentation edits with no executable or configuration changes. Content covers the pinned MLX/SDK submodule table (build.md 473-478), the App Attest release-qualification instructions (1102-1148), and the release-version check wording in test.md. The test.md hunks change the description of scripts/check-release-version.sh from comparing against the coordinator LatestProviderVersion to validating ProviderCore.version, with tag and binary matching. They also add descriptions of test-provider-release-resolution.py and test-provider-release-resume.py. These doc changes describe a script/CI behavior shift: the coordinator-retained version fallback is no longer a provider build input, and resume recovery reads only the original provider version. The documentation preserves the signed-tag, source-ancestry, successful-build/SDK and immutable-artifact requirements. Nothing in the diff weakens TB-011 or the T-053/T-054 binding and revocation boundaries, and it does not touch the A-011 or A-017 registries. The test.md unit 67373c0eff1153bd:0 is metadata-only with no visible content. The actual script and workflow changes (check-release-version.sh, provider-release resolver/resume scripts) are not in this batch, so whether the docs match the implementation cannot be verified here. A later pass should check those scripts if they are in the PR, especially that dropping the coordinator fallback does not weaken release/tag binding. No threat-model updates are needed from these doc edits alone.
